formattedAddress: No. 111號, Jingxing Rd, Jingdong Village, Wenshan District, Taipei City, Taiwan 116

text.text:
I'd eaten at the Banqiao branch before (I think it was the original location), and I was surprised to find one in Jingmei too. I was really impressed with their burgers, so as soon as I heard about this new place, I went to check it out to see if it tasted the same.

Today I ordered the Signature No. 2 (with cheese), a thick beef burger patty/thin-seared beef patty (with peanut butter chunks), and a pineapple burger. Unlike typical breakfast burgers, this one had both thinly sliced ​​beef and a thick burger patty. You could enjoy the deliciousness of the thinly sliced ​​beef while also experiencing the satisfying texture of the patty, all complemented by the rich aroma of cheese, the sweet peanut butter chunks, and finally, an extra egg and the sweet, slightly crispy pineapple patty. Each bite was bursting with flavor, the proportions of the ingredients perfectly balanced, making it incredibly satisfying! The portion was also very generous. Paired with a cup of slightly sweet Ceylon tea, it was the perfect way to start a wonderful day with a delicious breakfast.

The shop is small, with only a dozen or so seats. It's clean, tidy, and comfortable, with seats that aren't too crowded. The staff are also very friendly. I would definitely come back to try other flavors.

originalText.text:
之前在板橋吃過（應該是本店），沒想到在景美也開了一家，對於它的漢堡印象很深刻，所以知道有這家店之後立刻前往確認，是不是印象中的味道？
今天點了招牌2號（內含起司），純厚牛漢堡排/薄煎牛肉排（顆粒花生醬），配上菠蘿堡。跟一般的早餐店漢堡不一樣，ㄧ個漢堡內同時有有薄煎牛肉和厚實漢堡排，可以吃到薄牛肉的美味，同時又吃到漢堡排的厚實口感，再搭配上起司的濃厚香味，還有香甜的顆粒花生醬，最後再多加一顆蛋，還有菠蘿堡的香香甜甜微酥，一口咬下同時包含許多的味道，各種食材間比例搭配得宜，令人非常滿足！而且整體份量十足，再搭配上一杯微甜的錫蘭紅茶，美好的一天從美味的早餐開始。
店面小，只有10幾個座位，店裡乾淨、整齊、舒適，座位間不會太過擁擠，而且店員很親切，還會再來回訪，試試其他的口味。

text.text: This is a great breakfast shop. You can feel the care and attention the owner puts into every dish. Highly recommended!

originalText.text: 很不錯的早餐店，每一樣食物你都會感受到店家的用心，值得推薦！

text.text:
The dining environment is clean and hygienic!

I always forget to take pictures when I eat here, but today I finally remembered halfway through my meal. Please excuse the photos of the leftovers!

The peanut slices are still delicious, with a wonderful peanut aroma and great texture.

The chicken leg is still the best! Not greasy, crispy skin, and very juicy meat; every bite is satisfying.

Last time I had the chicken leg, it wasn't good. I don't know if it was fried too long or over-marinated. It had a slightly raw marinade taste, and I felt terrible after finishing the whole leg...

The Ceylon tea is good! Ordering ice or sugar makes it less sweet.

You need to be seated by the staff and register your information on the signboard first.

originalText.text:
用餐環境乾淨衛生！
每次來吃都忘了拍照，唉呀今天好不容易吃到一半想起來了。吃剩的照片請見諒！
花生薄片還是一樣好吃，花生香氣四溢顆粒感很棒。
還是雞腿好吃！不油膩皮脆肉汁很多，咬下去滿足感充足。
上次吃了一次雞腿排不好吃，不知道是下油鍋時間不對，還是醃製過頭。咬下去有點醃製的生味，整個雞腿排吃完謀吼甲。。。
錫蘭紅茶不錯喝！點冰跟糖都正常會比較不甜噢。
入位要由店員通知，要先登記在看板上。

text.text:
The signature dish of steak, teppanyaki noodles, and egg... how can it be so delicious?! 🥲

I've ordered delivery before and it was pretty good. The dine-in version is even better, needless to say.

But the only downside is the +15 upgrade to fresh milk tea 🤔. Judging from the color and taste, it seems like there's not much fresh milk added, so I don't think it's worth it.

originalText.text:
牛排+鐵板麵+蛋的招牌餐
怎麼會這麼好吃🥲

外送也叫過不錯吃
內用更好吃不用說

但唯有+15升級鮮奶茶🤔
看顏色&口味感覺鮮奶加的不多
覺得不太值得

text.text:
Visited: March 2025
[Overall]
A comfortable breakfast place.
The ingredients are high-quality and carefully selected.

[Food]
Both the pineapple burger and the regular burger were quite good.
Not too greasy.
The chicken thigh was very tender!
The tuna was tossed with mayonnaise.

[Environment]
For an affordable breakfast place, it's quite stylish.
The owner seems quite unique!
The overall smell of cooking oil was acceptable.

[Service]
The staff were super friendly.
They explained the dishes attentively and explained the special features.
They were also very patient with my questions!

originalText.text:
造訪時間：2025.03
【整體】
環境舒適的評價早餐店，
用料是吃得出品質跟用心的～

【食物】
菠蘿堡跟普通漢堡都還不錯，
不會很油，
雞腿排的部分很嫩！
鮪魚的話是跟美乃滋一起拌的type~

【環境】
以平價早餐店而言很有設計感，
感覺是個有個性的老闆！
然後整體的油煙味覺得還ok~

【服務】
服務人員超級親切，
會非常用心介紹餐點！
然後會說說餐點的特色，
問問題也都很有耐心唷！
